evidence.title: Shadesigner - A Shadcn Palette Generator & Theme Designer

name: Shadesigner
summary: Palette generator and theme designer for shadcn/ui projects, outputting WCAG-compliant themes.
description: Tool that generates color palettes for shadcn projects and edits existing themes, advertised as a 100% WCAG compliant theme generator. A palette showcase demonstrates every CSS variable used by the shadcn ui library (background, card, muted and accent colors, toggle switch).
contains: palette showcase of all shadcn CSS variables
